Guidance & outlook: I am happy to report that we commenced FY27 with strong double -digit growth, building on the formidable base of FY26.
As our branded business continues to gain scale across markets, we expect their share to exceed two-third of our overall revenue over the medium term.
I'm confident that the strategic choices that we have made over the last several years will build strong growth pillars for us in the long term.
Growth & demand: In the Pharmaceutical space, In India, our branded formulations business sustained market outperformance with a strong 20% year -on-year growth during the quarter.
The business sustained the growth momentum during the quarter and posted revenues of ₹ 9.7 billion with a year -on-year growth of 34%.
Within this, the international business, including the Comfort Click portfolio, de livered a like -to-like growth of 25%, while the domestic business grew 5% year-on-year.
Margins & costs: On the operating profitability front as well, our performance was robust with an EBITDA margin of 24.1%.
Consequently, EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹ 19.3 billion while net profit for the quarter stood at ₹ 9.4 billion.
But ideally, we would want to be improving our EBITDA margins to 28-30% range as we move closer to the 5-year period.
Capex & expansion: Largely, I would say, that about 80% increase in the cost is driven by acquisitions that we had in the last one year.

So, from the capex point of view, I think , a meaningful part of it obviously is setting up of the facilities, SEZ 3, which is coming, right now the completion of the expansion that we have done in our existing facilities for higher capacity, including Moraiya, Goa, Bad di and then Unit-2, Unit-3 at SEZ.
So, right now, we are guiding for around ₹1,500-₹1,600 crores capex.
Balance sheet & cash: Our net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 0.7 times as on 30th of June, 2026.
Risks & challenges: Seasonal brands, however, de -grew primarily due to the softer summer season.
